pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions; multi-ticket entries must only trigger on confirmed momentum breakout bars with a minimum 2.5 ATR distance between tranches.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume and order book imbalance confirmation combined with 15-minute ATR expansion filter prior to order dispatch.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stops once profit exceeds $8.00, targeting scale-out distributions at $15.00, $22.00, and $30.00.
